subject: Co-engineered runtime reseller ops, SLAs & go-live checklist
messages:
From: Danielle Huang <danielle@redleaf.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Co-engineered runtime reseller ops kickoff / draft SOW
Attachments: RL_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, integration_checklist.xlsx

Hi Aditya — great to meet last week. As discussed, RedLeaf wants Redwood runtime embedded into our reseller UI (white-label) with co-branded support for enterprise customers. Attached is a first-pass SOW and a short integration checklist the engineering team pulled together. High-level asks: 

- White-labeling: remove Redwood branding in the partner UI, include a small co-brand badge in About.
- Support: 24x5 L2 support for escalations, optional 24x7 at higher tier.
- SLA: target 99.9 latency availability for p95 on production traffic; need fallback behavior if our tenant is constrained.
- Revenue share: proposal was 70/30 in favor of RedLeaf for self-serve customers, with a rev-share for enterprise deals to be negotiated.
- Data: we need clarity on data residency and audit logs for customers in the EU.

Can you review the attached and share Redwood's preferred ops model and any hard constraints? We'd like to kick off a pilot in August and finalize commercials before the end of July.

Thanks —
Danielle Huang
Head of Partnerships, RedLeaf AI

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Huang <danielle@redleaf.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-engineered runtime reseller ops kickoff / draft SOW
Attachments: (see RL_SOW_draft_v1.pdf comments)

Thanks Danielle — I reviewed the SOW and checklist. Agreed this is a good shape to start with. A few clarifying items from our side before we move to commercial terms: 

1) Deployment model: we can support three patterns: Hosted multi-tenant (fastest), Dedicated tenant (reserved capacity for RedLeaf), and Private (VPC/on-prem). For white-label in your SAAS UI we usually recommend Dedicated tenant for predictable SLAs and clear separation.

2) Branding constraints: we can remove product-level Redwood marks inside your UI. We need to keep a minimal legal attribution in the Terms (one-line). If you require full removal of any mention, legal will need to approve a brand waiver.

3) SLAs & fallback: 99.9 is reasonable with Dedicated and a modest committed capacity. We will propose a fallback policy (auto-route to a compatible lower-cost variant or degrade to cached responses) that you can show to customers. Need to align on p95 vs p99.

4) Data residency & audit logs: we can host EU tenant + deliver audit logs (retention configurable). For enterprise customers that require HSM/KMS integration, that will be in the Private option.

5) Commercials: Ben (cc'd) will lead the pricing model. We'll prepare a co-engineered pricing matrix with options: pilot (3 months, limited throughput), go-live (monthly commit), and enterprise (annual commit, premium SLA).

Monica, can you review the technical checklist and call out anything blocking for a mid-August pilot?

Next steps: Ben and I will share a revised pricing matrix and tracked SOW comments by Thursday. Danielle — are you able to take redlines and sign a short MPA (starter term) so we can begin provisioning? We have a DocuSign link we can circulate.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Huang <danielle@redleaf.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-engineered runtime reseller ops kickoff / draft SOW
Attachments: coengineer_pricing_matrix.xlsx

Adding operational detail from my side — draft ops & SLA options for the Dedicated-tenant path (this keeps branding control + predictable latency):

- Provisioning: 2-week lead time for a dedicated tenant (GPU sizing depends on pilot throughput).
- Monitoring: per-tenant dashboards in Redwood Console (latency, token spend, traces). We can enable alerting to your PagerDuty and provide token-level cost breakdowns.
- Failover: automatic fallback to cached prefixes + queueing for write-heavy bursts. For critical flows we recommend a warm standby model.
- Support model: Tier A (business hours L2 + on-call), Tier B (24x5 L2 + escalation), Tier C (24x7 with guaranteed M1 response). Tier C requires reserved capacity and a higher monthly minimum.
- SLAs: 
  * Pilot: p95 availability target 99.0 (no financial credits)
  * Standard (monthly commit): p95 target 99.9 with credits; p99 target option for an uplift

Pricing notes attached — the matrix has pilot vs committed vs enterprise. Key trade-offs: availability guarantees and revenue share change materially with reserved commit.

Camila Reyes
VP, Partnerships & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Huang <danielle@redleaf.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-engineered runtime reseller ops kickoff / draft SOW
Attachments: integration_checklist.xlsx (annotated)

Danielle / team — quick technical readout on the integration checklist and a few callouts we need in the SOW: 

- Runtime variant: recommend Redwood-rt-dedicated-1 (8xA100 equivalent) for your initial pilot to match p95 latency targets.
- API contract: we'll expose a partner SDK and a stable API surface; please plan for a 1-week ops window to complete OAuth client onboarding and webhook verification.
- KV / prefix caching: to meet p95 targets, we strongly suggest pre-warming common prefixes (we can assist with scripts).
- Model artifacts: the MPA must include a "model weight protection" clause—no redistribution of weights or model training on partner-owned weights.
- Compliance: for EU customers we will provision a restricted EU tenant. Audit log delivery is S3-compatible export (daily) or direct API pull.

DocuSign link to starter MPA: https://docusign.com/initiate/MPA-7842 — if we get a countersign this week we can start provisioning the pilot next Monday.

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-engineered runtime reseller ops kickoff / draft SOW
Attachments: (pricing matrix attached in previous email)

Danielle — thanks for the fast turnaround. Putting commercial next steps here so we have a single thread: 

1) Pilot commit: 3 months, up to 50k tokens/day, price as listed in coengineer_pricing_matrix.xlsx. Pilot gives RedLeaf the right to white-label the runtime UI for self-serve customers; enterprise resales will flow through the reseller revenue-share schedule.
2) Go-live: target 2026-09-01 for go-live after successful pilot. Go-live requires a monthly commit (TBD) for Dedicated tenant sizing.
3) SLA & credits: standard p95 99.9 with financial credits tiered by severity. We will include fallback rules in the appendix to the SOW (Camila / Monica to draft).
4) Contracting: We request countersignature on the starter MPA (DocuSign link below) to enable provisioning. The full SOW can be attached as an exhibit and redlines tracked in the shared PDF.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/initiate/MPA-7842
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company.com/deals/7842

If this aligns, we'll turn the pricing matrix into a formal quote and circulate the DocuSign for signature today.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Partnerships, Redwood Inference
